title: Terms, definitions and measurements to describe the sonographic features of adnexal tumors: updated consensus opinion from the International Ovarian Tumor Analysis (IOTA) Group
organization: International Ovarian Tumor Analysis (IOTA) Group & ISUOG
target_population: Patients undergoing transvaginal / transabdominal pelvic ultrasound for ovarian or adnexal mass characterization.
intended_use: Standardized morphological terms, measurement protocols (3 orthogonal planes), definitions of solid components vs clots/mucin, and definitions of vascularity scoring (Color Score 1 to 4).

key_definitions.lesion: The part of an ovary or adnexal mass that is judged not to be normal physiology.
key_definitions.solid_component: A structure that has the echogenicity of parenchymal tissue (tissue-like). Shadowing or Doppler blood flow confirms solid tissue; avascularity with acoustic streaming or change on pressure indicates debris/clot.
key_definitions.papillary_projection: Any solid projection with height ≥ 3 mm arising from the cyst wall or a septum and protruding into the cyst cavity.
key_definitions.septum: A thin strand of tissue running across the cyst cavity from one internal surface to the contralateral internal surface. An incomplete septum does not cross the entire cavity (characteristic of hydrosalpinx).
key_definitions.unilocular_cyst: A cyst with a single cavity, no septa, and no solid components or papillary projections.
key_definitions.unilocular_solid: A unilocular cyst containing one or more solid components or papillary projections.
key_definitions.multilocular_cyst: A cyst with at least two internal cavities separated by one or more complete septa, without solid components.
key_definitions.multilocular_solid: A multilocular cyst containing at least one solid component or papillary projection.
key_definitions.solid_tumor: A tumor where the solid components comprise ≥ 80% of the lesion when assessed in two-dimensional sections.

standardized_color_score.Score 1: No blood flow detected within the lesion (Avascular).
standardized_color_score.Score 2: Minimal blood flow detected (Few scattered color pixels).
standardized_color_score.Score 3: Moderate blood flow detected (Clear vessel structures).
standardized_color_score.Score 4: Very strong / abundant blood flow detected (High velocity, chaotic branching).
